item.title: Yaritai Onna Tsundere Teacher
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: DENZO
  • 発売日: 2006-12-29
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: やりたい女 ツンデレ・ティーチャー
  • 英語名: Yaritai Onna Tsundere Teacher

あらすじ

Main character attends preparatory school at summer. His English teacher Haruka is always very strict. There is also Kana girl who attends the same classes and who likes kissing while still being a virgin. One day protagonist forces Kana to fellatio without knowing that they are being watched by teacher Haruka. Soon boy is called to Haruka sensei room where he gets reversely harassed. Which relations will he pursue? Or, perhaps, both?
